compendium.summary: A normal 2024 Wizard option for party protection against hostile magic. Prepare it for spell-heavy opposition when defending nearby allies is worth your concentration.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: Available with fifth-level Wizard spells: Wizard 9, or character 10 after a one-level dip. Do not use the old Paladin-only access assumption for a 2024 Wizard.
Compare protecting the group with separating enemy casters using Wall of Force. The aura requires proximity; avoid unnecessary clustering and preserve an escape route.

Within the 30-foot Emanation, you and allies have Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. When such an effect permits a save for half damage, a successful save instead means no damage; a failed save does not gain blanket resistance.
